card.statement:
More generally, if $M$ is a finitely generated $\mathbf{k}$ -module, we can consider the perverse sheaves

$\mathcal{J}_{!}(\lambda,M):={}^{p}\hskip-1.0pt\mathscr{H}^{0}\bigl((j_{\lambda})_{!}\underline{M}_{\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}^{\lambda}}[\dim\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}^{\lambda}]\bigr),\quad\mathcal{J}_{*}(\lambda,M):={}^{p}\hskip-1.0pt\mathscr{H}^{0}\bigl((j_{\lambda})_{*}\underline{M}_{\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}^{\lambda}}[\dim\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}^{\lambda}]\bigr).$

Considerations similar to those in the proof of Proposition 11.1 show that there exist canonical isomorphisms

$\mathsf{F}_{\mu}(\mathcal{J}_{!}(\lambda,M))\cong\mathsf{F}_{\mu}(\mathcal{J}_{!}(\lambda,\mathbf{k}))\otimes_{\mathbf{k}}M,\quad\mathsf{F}_{\mu}(\mathcal{J}_{*}(\lambda,M))\cong\mathsf{F}_{\mu}(\mathcal{J}_{*}(\lambda,\mathbf{k}))\otimes_{\mathbf{k}}M$

(11.1)

for any $\mu\in X_{*}(T)$.

11.2 Extension of scalars

In the following proposition, we denote by

$\mathbf{k}\mathchoice{\mathbin{\mathop{\otimes}^{L}}_{\mathbf{Z}}}{\otimes^{L}_{\mathbf{Z}}}{\otimes^{L}_{\mathbf{Z}}}{\otimes^{L}_{\mathbf{Z}}}(\bm{?}):D^{\mathrm{b}}_{c,{G_{\mathcal{O}}}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathbf{Z})\to D^{\mathrm{b}}_{c,{G_{\mathcal{O}}}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathbf{k})$

the (derived) extension-of-scalars functor. (Note that this functor does not send perverse sheaves to perverse sheaves.) Below we will use this notation also for varieties other than $\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}$.
card.label: Remark 11.2

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
